name: Button
purpose: Commit or trigger one action.
usage: Use one primary per view. Danger is only for confirmation.
behavior: Native disabled and loading prevent activation. Label remains visible.
avoid: Use a link for navigation. Do not use arbitrary colour or style props.

name: IconButton
purpose: A compact action represented by an approved glyph.
usage: Supply a label that describes the action.
behavior: Accessible name is required. Native button semantics.
avoid: Use Button when a visible label would help.

name: Icon
purpose: An approved decorative Klein glyph.
usage: Meaning belongs in the parent control label.
behavior: Hidden from assistive technology.
avoid: Do not import a separate icon library or draw page-local icons.

name: Input
purpose: Native text entry for custom field composition.
usage: Prefer Field. Standalone Input needs an accessible label.
behavior: Use native value/onChange and inputMode for numeric entry.
avoid: No checkbox/radio/file variants; those require dedicated components.

name: Field
purpose: Text entry with an associated label, help and error.
usage: The caller validates and supplies error text.
behavior: Label and help/error IDs are generated; disabled/readOnly/required stay native.
avoid: Do not use placeholders as labels. Use one field per Field.

name: NumericValue
purpose: Already formatted money, dates, percentages and measured values.
usage: Pass locale-aware text; choose semantic tone in the data layer.
behavior: Uses monospace tabular numerals.
avoid: Never infer good/bad from arithmetic sign or calculate totals here.

name: PageHeader
purpose: The page title and its primary actions.
usage: One h1 and at most one primary action per page.
behavior: Actions wrap at narrow widths.
avoid: No prose lead, invented subtitle or duplicated header.

name: RouteTabs
purpose: Navigation between routes.
usage: The application supplies hrefs and current route ID.
behavior: Real links; aria-current marks the active page.
avoid: Use Tabs for local panels. Do not drive page routes with local tab state.

name: Tabs
purpose: Controlled selection between local panels.
usage: Use inside a drawer or a local panel, not page sub-navigation.
behavior: Arrow/Home/End move focus; Enter/Space activate. Disabled tabs are skipped.
avoid: Do not replace RouteTabs or duplicate navigation state.

name: ViewControlPanel
purpose: The single control region above a view body.
usage: Supply approved controls and trailing actions.
behavior: Mixed native controls retain normal Tab order.
avoid: Do not add a second toolbar; extend the actions slot.

name: ViewSection
purpose: A flat titled region inside a view.
usage: Use for a chart or sub-list in an approved layout.
behavior: Heading and optional actions share a band.
avoid: Do not wrap it in a decorative Card or add shadow/rounded corners.

name: ViewLayout
purpose: One of five approved view-body layouts.
usage: Choose single, 2:1, 2:2, 3:3 or tree:detail.
behavior: Owns internal gutters and scroll behaviour. Grids stack on narrow screens.
avoid: Do not add page padding or recreate these grids in consumers.

name: ListViewTemplate
purpose: Canonical header, navigation, controls and scrolling body.
usage: Supply PageHeader, optional RouteTabs, one ViewControlPanel and body.
behavior: Place in a height-constrained application shell; body scrolls independently.
avoid: No backend, router or saved preference state belongs here.

name: EdgeToEdgeLayout
purpose: A full-width dashboard stack with hairline-separated bands.
usage: Use for edge-to-edge product surfaces, with no outer padding or decorative cards.
behavior: Bands own gutters; narrow layouts stack; grow fills the parent.
avoid: Do not add gaps between bands or wrap tables in padded containers.

name: DashboardBand
purpose: One full-width dashboard band; flush makes tables edge-to-edge.
usage: Use for edge-to-edge product surfaces, with no outer padding or decorative cards.
behavior: Bands own gutters; narrow layouts stack; grow fills the parent.
avoid: Do not add gaps between bands or wrap tables in padded containers.

name: SplitBand

name: Table
purpose: Semantic, controlled table using the shared renderer.
usage: Supply display-ready values and callbacks. See the typed example and props below.
behavior: Rendering and interaction only; the application owns queries, permissions, calculations and persistence.
avoid: Do not copy the renderer, pass arbitrary CSS, or fetch data inside the component.

name: Chart
purpose: Chart.js renderer with a closed series API.
usage: Supply display-ready series; use pointIds with onPointSelect for interaction. The data table provides keyboard access to the same points. Use height="fill" only inside a bounded parent.
behavior: Supports bar, line, area, pie and doughnut. Target lines stay outside stacked totals; null remains missing. The adapter supplies formatting, axis bounds and filter matches.
avoid: Do not copy the renderer, pass arbitrary CSS, or fetch data inside the component.

usage: Supply the native top strip and sidebar as slots. Compose the page header and body as children. The body owns scrolling.

purpose: Show prepared opening, movement and closing bars with an optional aligned companion series.
usage: The adapter supplies floating ranges, signed labels, tooltip lines and semantic tones. Secondary values must correspond to the same columns.
behavior: Bar and secondary panels align their left axes. Missing secondary values remain gaps. Accessible data can be expanded below the plots.
avoid: Do not compute running totals, permissions or financial values in the renderer. Do not put differently scaled series on the same axis.

usage: Supply precomputed percentages and formatted values. Use seriesId to keep related reported and estimated segments visually paired.
behavior: Estimated values use a patterned legend. Help controls work by keyboard. Values remain visible beside the chart.
avoid: Do not calculate cost classifications or monetary totals in the renderer. Do not supply arbitrary colors or SVG geometry.

name: Notice
purpose: Explain a condition and offer an optional recovery action.
usage: Supply a title, explanation, semantic tone and optional canonical action. Set urgent only for newly occurring errors requiring immediate attention.
behavior: Static notices have a labelled section; urgent errors use the alert live-region role.
avoid: Do not create feature-specific colored warning boxes or announce every static notice.

name: EddyLaunchpad
purpose: Start a question or choose a grouped, permission-filtered suggestion.
usage: Control the draft and supply localized suggestions already filtered by viewer permissions. Handle submit and suggestion IDs in the application.
behavior: Enter submits non-empty drafts; Shift+Enter adds a line; composition input is not prematurely submitted. Decorative currents respect reduced motion.
avoid: Do not fetch permissions, resolve routes, send messages or persist drafts inside this component.

name: PanZoomCanvas
purpose: Navigate large diagrams with pointer pan, wheel/pinch zoom, fit and reset.
usage: Place in a bounded-height container. Pass prepared diagram content and optionally a focus anchor getter for large structures. Use the ref for external Fit and Reset controls.
behavior: Fits once after ready. Keyboard arrows pan, plus/minus zoom and Home resets. Controls inside the content retain their own keyboard behavior.
avoid: Do not build a feature-local gesture engine or put hierarchy queries and business filtering in the canvas.

name: HierarchyTree
purpose: Arrange prepared nodes as a hierarchy with shared hairline connectors.
usage: Supply acyclic roots with stable IDs and display-ready cards. Compose inside PanZoomCanvas for large structures. The application controls ordering, filtering and collapsed branches.
behavior: Uses nested semantic lists and content-driven connector geometry. Optional padded mode supplies the standalone gutter.
avoid: Do not recreate connector CSS in a feature, or put hierarchy queries and permission checks inside this renderer.

name: AssignmentCard
purpose: Show a responsibility, its capacity and its assigned people or resources.
usage: Supply formatted values and date descriptions. Handle selected IDs in the app; optional drag bindings and context-menu adapters preserve feature interactions.
behavior: Heading and entries are separate keyboard actions. Drag and drop emphasis is controlled by the application. Native event/ref forwarding supports context-menu composition.
avoid: Do not calculate allocations, infer employee types or query occupancy from this renderer.

name: HierarchySummaryCard
purpose: Summarize a hierarchy node with independent detail, related-record and descendant actions.
usage: Supply localized metrics and controlled expansion states. Permission filtering, fetching related records and navigation remain in the app.
behavior: Each action is a native button; related records and child branches expand independently. Indicators sit outside the expansion button so their own tooltips/actions remain valid.
avoid: Do not conflate branch expansion with loading records or reproduce this card inside an explorer.

name: ReviewSequence
purpose: Show ordered review stages with accessible reviewer and status explanations.
usage: Sort and map business statuses in the data adapter. Supply prepared labels, details, tones and symbols; compact mode is for table rows.
behavior: Preserves supplied order. Explanations open on keyboard focus and hover; status meaning is provided by text and symbols as well as color.
avoid: Do not calculate the current approver or compare timestamps inside the renderer.

name: RankedBars
purpose: Compare ranked values using prepared proportional bars and optional selection.
usage: Prepare ordering, top-N limits, percentages and formatted values in the data adapter. Pass value/onValueChange for interactive filtering.
behavior: Selections use stable IDs and native buttons. Unselected rows dim without disappearing. Zero, empty and loading states do not invent values.
avoid: Do not create clickable div charts or aggregate costs inside the renderer.

name: SegmentedBar
purpose: Show prepared shares consistently in a compact row or summary band.
usage: Supply percentages, formatted amounts, optional share labels and stable series indices or semantic tones. The adapter owns provider folding, currency formatting and coverage calculations.
behavior: Bar and legend use one palette mapping. Hidden legends remain accessible within the component’s scrolling boundary.
avoid: Do not calculate financial totals or accept arbitrary CSS colors in a feature-local split bar.

name: BreakdownTable
purpose: Dense labelled metrics with a trailing proportional share bar.
usage: Supply ordered display cells, stable row/column IDs, prepared percentages and localized share labels. Use TableCollection when filters, sorting and properties are required.
behavior: Rows activate through pointer, Enter or Space; nested controls keep their own keyboard behavior. Zero shares remain zero.
avoid: Do not build a new metric-list table or calculate rankings inside the renderer.

name: RangeTrack
purpose: Prepared interval geometry with proportional gridlines and optional drag handles.
usage: Supply percentages, column weights and formatted labels. Keep date conversion and persistence in an adapter. Pair pointer editing with accessible date fields.
behavior: Clamps geometry to the visible track. Emits pointer gestures without calculating or mutating dates.
avoid: Do not pass domain timelines, queries or custom CSS.

name: ValueTransition

avoid: Do not add allocation logic or financial comparisons to the renderer.
